The test image shows soybean leaves, mostly green but with small yellowish patches and some reddish-brown lesions visible on background leaves. The lesions appear on the upper leaf surface. Top candidates: Downy mildew (light green to yellow spots), Septoria brown spot, Soybean rust, Frogeye leaf spot.

Let me view one reference from each top candidate.
Downy mildew reference shows many small light-green/yellow spots densely scattered. The test image has a few spots but less dense. Let me check Septoria brown spot.
Septoria reference shows heavy yellowing with dark spots - more severe than the test image. Let me check Frogeye leaf spot.
Frogeye shows small circular spots with reddish-brown borders. The test image has small spots that could match. Let me use my 4th view on Downy mildew to confirm vs. the early stage seen in the test.

The second downy mildew reference (Soybean_Dise_75) shows exactly the same pattern as the test image: a few scattered small pale-yellow spots on an otherwise green upper leaf surface, with early-stage infection. This matches the test image very closely.

**Analysis:**
- Test image: leaf, mostly green, small pale-yellow spots scattered on upper surface visible on background leaves, some reddish-brown marks
- Downy mildew early stage (Soybean_Dise_75): identical — few small pale-yellow spots on upper leaf of green plant
- Septoria brown spot: more severe, with dark brown lesions and heavy yellowing
- Frogeye: circular spots with distinct reddish-purple borders, different pattern
- Downy mildew description fits perfectly: "Small light green spots on upper leaf surfaces that enlarge and turn pale to bright yellow"
